summary: Core scalar-loss gradient derivation gives uncontracted tensor Jacobians. Test-dependent checkpoint selection is Major for the frozen release's core evaluation protocol; the training-mode defect remains Minor. Historical benchmark impact remains unresolved.

problems.title: Scalar-loss gradients omit the chain rule
problems.claim: Section3.3 Eqs12–20 identify factor outer products as gradients of scalar L.
assumptions: Differentiable scalar loss; effective W=W0+alpha sum(lambda outer factors).
FFN l1,d2,R1,shape9x2x2; alpha3,lambda2,all factors first basis vectors.
problems.check: Independent exact quadratic differentiation gives loss18, dL/dlambda18, factor active derivative36; printed objects have active entry1 and wrong output shape.
problems.result: Missing upstream gradient contraction, scale and original-coordinate coefficient factors.
problems.counterevidence: AppendixA validly computes tensor-update Jacobians and absorbs lambda into first factor. Current implementation uses autograd and separate lambda, not displayed custom backward.
problems.impact: Invalid derivation directly concerns core method; does not establish wrong autograd gradients or benchmark scores.

correction.statement: For G=dL/dW, coefficient gradient alpha inner(G,outer factors); factor gradient alpha lambda contraction(G,other factors).

problems.title: Released training selects checkpoints using test labels
problems.claim: Released VTAB training interface intended to support paper's evaluation.
assumptions: Ordinary training branch; train800val200/test file names have advertised split meanings.
problems.check: evaluate=True supplies test.txt as second loader; train tests it every10epochs, updates best_acc and saves maximizing checkpoint; final score also enters maximum.
problems.result: Test-dependent checkpoint selection and max-score reporting in current release.
problems.counterevidence: Combined1000-sample final fit may be legitimate; other branch offers validation; commit not bound to historical paper runs.
problems.impact: Material failure of the frozen release's core evaluation protocol: test labels determine checkpoint selection and the reported maximum, so the measurement is not an independent held-out evaluation. No quantified bias or attribution to historical Table 2 is established; those remain Needs Evidence.

correction.statement: Select by validation and use final test once; complete revised run not performed.

problems.title: Evaluation mode persists into subsequent training
problems.claim: Training loop performs100epochs with intermediate evaluation.
assumptions: First periodic evaluation reached; dropout-sensitive modules exist as declared.
problems.check: model.train before loop, model.eval in test, no restoration after test or at epoch start.
problems.result: Subsequent optimizer updates retain eval-mode stochastic behavior.
problems.counterevidence: Autograd continues; no measured effect or historical provenance; possible intentional schedule not documented.
problems.impact: Local training procedure inconsistency; historical effect unresolved.

correction.statement: Restore prior training state after evaluation; no author code modified or run.

repair_verification: Scalar chain rule locally verified; training protocol repairs not run.
limitations: No author code/tests/training/weight or dataset downloads.
Swin/GLUE and saliency experiments not reproduced; AppendixD tables not comprehensively recalculated.
